levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر

notes: «رواه الوليد بن مسلم عن ابن جابر» names a different transmitter for the same saying, so it is a variant group, not a route (rule 4).
«مولى، امرأته أم عثمان» is read as one transmitter named by his client-status; the text gives no other name for him.
The remark «وقال مولى امرأته أم عثمان بن عطاء» and the wording «بالربائث» are left out.
Ali relays the Prophet's words; the Prophet is not a link.
